informal_statement: An admissible type-\(\mathrm B\) angle of area \(v\) contributes its perimeter to the type-\(\mathrm B\) value set at \(v\).
reason: `CMVBallCase.lean:1088-1092`: The only hypotheses are angular admissibility and the area equation. The angle itself is the existential witness for its perimeter's membership; no density or uniqueness hypothesis is added.
